displayPattern: Status LED: 4 short flashes then 8 long flashes (Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump and 24VNA9 air conditioner; amber status LED on the outdoor control). The earlier, local version of this fault is code 33.
meaning: Lost inverter communications (system malfunction): the outdoor control (AOC) and the inverter (MOC) have stopped communicating. Fault 33 is logged after 2 minutes with no communication and is elevated to 48 after 3 consecutive failures within 20 minutes, or 20 minutes of continuous loss of connection.
causes: Loose or disconnected harness between the AOC (PL20) and the MOC
diySteps: Note the flash pattern on the amber status LED: 4 short flashes then 8 long flashes is 48; 3 short then 3 long is 33. Short flashes give the first digit and long flashes the second
For radio or electrical noise, the manual says the system will try to self-mitigate with repeated start attempts
Technician: verify a good harness connection between the AOC (PL20) and the MOC
Technician: on the inverter's MOC board, a steady green LD5 indicates the 5 volt connection between AOC and MOC is OK, and a blinking amber LED3 indicates communication from the MOC to the AOC
Technician: if the harness is good, the manual's action for possible inverter damage is to change out the inverter drive
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: fault 48 involves the harness inside the outdoor unit and possibly the inverter drive, both of which carry high voltage.
sourceTitle: Carrier Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump / 24VNA9 air conditioner Service Manual (4SM)
